messages:
maya: Rolling a staggered region-by-region rollout for model v3.0.0 -> v3.0.1. Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Canary plan: US 8% -> 40% -> 100%, EU 20% -> 60% -> 100%, APAC hold until warm pool + KV prefetch verified. Change window 23:00-03:00 UTC. fallback_pin=v2.9.8. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/3.0.1 (breaking perf note). cc @kevin @olga

deploy-bot: preflight checks (roll-1723456789): infra=OK, build_checksum=ok, warm_pools: US=ready, EU=ready, APAC=quota_insufficient(+3 GPUs requested). certs: OK. policies: autoscaler=standard.

kevin: APAC quota short. @sre-oncall can you approve +3 GPUs for the APAC warm pool for 4h? est cost ~ $150/hr.

sre-oncall: Approved +3 GPUs for APAC (prov=apac-provision-334). Thermal cap set -> 80% util. Will monitor eviction and host temps.

olga: perf baseline (seq=512): p99 US=210ms EU=235ms APAC=270ms. v3.0.1 expected +8-12% CPU. Suggest APAC start at 5% canary.

maya: updated manifest: model=3.0.1, fallback=2.9.8, slices={us:8,eu:20,apac:5}, canary_window=25m. pushed: https://internal.redwood/deploys/roll-1723456789/manifest

deploy-bot: rollout started by maya. beginning US canary. logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/roll-1723456789

harry: US canary smoke: all checks green. basic eval harness passed; token cost +3%. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: EU canary starting now. EU slice will be gated on kms/audit flags.

olga: EU compliance: kms_key missing for eu-west-1 slice. blocking ramp. Please set kms_key_id=key-eu-prod before EU >25%.

maya: acknowledged. pausing EU ramp; tim can you set the EU kms in config?

tim: applying kms change... command: `infractl set-kms --slice eu --key key-eu-prod && infractl apply --slice eu`

deploy-bot: kms change applied, EU slice now shows audit_retention=enabled, kms_key_id=key-eu-prod. Resuming EU canary.

harry: EU canary running. At +12m saw p95 jump -> 480ms and a spike in long-prompt rejects. Error rate up 0.3% (baseline 0.05%).

olga: likely related to KV cold misses on the quantized path. Recommend slow ramp: cap EU to 40% and extend canary by +30m.

maya: accepted. adjusting EU ramp to 40% and canary_window to 55m. Command: `deployctl set-roll --slice eu --pct 40 --window 55m`

deploy-bot: EU slice adjusted. monitoring rules updated.

deploy-bot: APAC warm pool provisioning failed initial disk-prefetch healthchecks (io_wait high). Provisioned +3 GPUs but disk warming timed out.

kevin: APAC failed KV prefetch - disk io contention on hostpool. @sre-oncall any quick mitigation?

sre-oncall: spun up fallback hostpool w/ dedicated nvme for KV priming. Trying reattach. If APAC p95 > 500ms for 5m after retry, we'll revert APAC slice to v2.9.8.

deploy-bot: APAC retry attempted. KV prefetch 75% complete, but worker-7 hitting OOM on quantized loader.

maya: decision: abort APAC canary and revert APAC traffic to fallback v2.9.8. Commanding slice rollback to avoid user impact.

maya: (audit command) `deployctl rollback --slice apac --to 2.9.8 --reason "KV prefetch failure + OOMs"`

deploy-bot: action logged: APAC reverted to 2.9.8, canary aborted. logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/roll-1723456789/apac-revert. Notification posted to #ops and #release-updates. final_slice_status: apac=reverted

kevin: filing follow-ups: INFRA-4120 (APAC disk priming + hostpool sizing), RUNTIME-830 (OOM during quantized loader). tagging @eng-runtime @eng-infra.

harry: US and EU remain on 3.0.1 (EU at 40% ramp). Observability shows no further error drift after EU adjustment.

sre-oncall: will keep the extra APAC GPUs for 2h buffer and then deprovision if no retest scheduled.

maya: notes for comms: 1) mark APAC as deferred in release notes, 2) add example slice-only rollback to runbook, 3) follow-up JIRAs as noted. I'll update release page and ping #release-updates.

deploy-bot: rollout finished with partial_success. slices: us=3.0.1, eu=3.0.1 (40% ramp), apac=2.9.8 (reverted). uid=roll-1723456789 final_status=partial_success

maya: thanks all — closing this coordination thread. Will reopen if APAC retest scheduled. :clap:
